{{reconstructed}}
==Proto-Semitic==

===Etymology===
Reconstructed in Militarev & Kogan's ''Semitic Etymological Dictionary'' as {{m|sem-pro||*ʕala/ūḳ(-at)-}}, i.e. {{m|sem-pro||*ʕalaḳ-}} (Arabic, Ethiopic, Aramaic) or {{m|sem-pro||*ʕalūḳ-}} (Hebrew {{m|hbo|עֲלוּקָה}}, Syriac {{m|syc|ܥܠܘܩܐ|tr=ʕalūḳā}}), with an optional feminine suffix {{m|sem-pro||*-at-}}. The Akkadian word is attested once, in a medical text whose translation is uncertain.
